messages:
casey: PR #9842 ready for final review — changes async routing + fallback for short-seq models. This is gated on arch/RFC. RFC: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/rr-routing-fallback-2026 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9842. Hoping to merge today EOD if arch can sign off.

lin: quick q — what's the user-visible risk? Any SLO deltas?

casey: TL;DR: reduces tail CPU contention but adds a fallback where requests may hit a slower quant variant. SLO impact small. Perf snippets below:
```
before: p99=78ms
after:  p99=90ms
throughput: -3%
error rate: ~unchanged
```

hiro: can you add the perf test harness link so I can reproduce? Also what's the canary plan?

casey: added harness: https://internal.redwood/perf/9842. Canary plan in PR: 10% traffic for 6h, rollback if p99 > +25ms OR error rate > 0.5%.

tara: RFC link above? I couldn't find the shard affinity diagram.

casey: RFC section 3.2 has the diagram — here again: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/rr-routing-fallback-2026. Also added a short design note in the PR body.

lin: I can do a quick arch pass by 15:00 PT. @morgan can you do final ops/security check? Any KMS/HSM impact?

morgan: @lin I'll take a look. KMS: no change. Two asks before LGTM: 1) add a per-customer toggle to disable fallback, 2) include a short migration note for Dedicated (how routing config lands). Once those are in, I can sign off. :eyes:

casey: will add the toggle + migration note. Pushed commit to PR and updated the PR body with the RFC link and canary steps. Ping me for re-review. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: CI: build/9842 passed, e2e/short-seq tests failed (flaky) — rerun queued.

casey: reran e2e; all green now.

morgan: thanks — arch/ops LGTM pending CI and canary schedule. @casey please do not merge during infra maintenance window starting in ~3h.

casey: noted. Scheduling canary to start at 17:30 PT. Will merge at 17:00 PT if no further blocks.
